description: This source file defines a custom recovery UI class for Cuttlefish, a virtual device environment, extending EthernetRecoveryUI, and provides a factory function to create an EthernetDevice with this UI.

classes.name: CuttlefishRecoveryUI
classes.description: A subclass of EthernetRecoveryUI that overrides the IsUsbConnected method to always return true, indicating a simulated USB connection in the Cuttlefish environment.

methods.name: make_device
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a new EthernetDevice initialized with a CuttlefishRecoveryUI instance and the network interface 'eth1'.
